summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser and tests. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests plus test/test_path.py pass (43 passed) under the prepared venv. Not verified: mypy and black are not installed in the venv, so type-checking and black formatting were only checked by reading; black may reflow the TypeError raise in shacl.py. Design choice: a non-node guard (any node that is not a URIRef or BNode raises SHACLPathError before lookups) because graph.value(None, ...) acts as a wildcard. Nothing was committed.
